symptom: Fridge/freezer does not operate or temperature is warm
possible_cause: Power cord not plugged in properly; temperature control not set correctly; located near heat source or direct sunlight; insufficient clearance between refrigerator and sides/rear; vacation mode activated; refrigerator overloaded with food blocking vents.
solution:
1. Properly plug in the power cord.
2. Set the temperature lower.
3. Keep the refrigerator away from direct sunlight or a heat source.
4. Ensure the gap between the refrigerator and nearby walls (or cabinets) is more than 50 mm.
5. Deactivate vacation mode.
6. Do not overload the refrigerator and do not allow food to block ventilation.
safety_warning: Keep the refrigerator away from direct sunlight or a heat source.
chunk_text: If the fridge/freezer does not operate or the fridge/freezer temperature is warm, possible causes include: power cord is not plugged in properly; temperature control is not set correctly; refrigerator is located near a heat source or direct sunlight; not enough clearance between refrigerator and sides/rear; vacation mode is activated; or the refrigerator is overloaded with food blocking the refrigerator vents. To resolve this: Properly plug in the power cord. Set the temperature lower. Keep the refrigerator away from direct sunlight or a heat source. Maintain a gap between the refrigerator and nearby walls (or cabinets) of more than 50 mm. Deactivate vacation mode. Do not overload the refrigerator and do not allow food to block ventilation.

possible_cause: Temperature control is not set correctly.

chunk_text: If the fridge/freezer is over-cooling, the temperature control may not be set correctly. To resolve this, set the temperature higher.

possible_cause: Refrigerator has heat-proof piping in the interior wall to prevent condensation from forming in the front corners.
safety_warning: Interior wall has heat-proof piping.
chunk_text: If the interior wall is hot, the refrigerator has heat-proof piping in the interior wall. To prevent condensation from forming, the refrigerator has heat-proof piping in the front corners. If the ambient temperature rises, this equipment may not work effectively. This is normal and not a system failure.

possible_cause: Spoiled food or food with strong odours.
solution:

2. Make sure strong smelling food is wrapped airtight.
chunk_text: If the refrigerator has odours, the possible causes are spoiled food or food with strong odours. To resolve this: Clean the refrigerator and remove any spoiled food, and make sure strong smelling food is wrapped airtight.

symptom: Condensation forms on the interior walls

solution:
1. Remove the moisture and do not open the door for a long time.
2. Make sure food is wrapped airtight.
chunk_text: If condensation forms on the interior walls, possible causes are: if the door is left open, moisture enters the refrigerator; or food with high moisture content is stored. To resolve this: Remove the moisture and do not open the door for a long time, and make sure food is wrapped airtight.

symptom: The ice maker does not produce ice
possible_cause: Freezer room not cold enough; wire connector of ice maker not connected properly; water line flowing to ice maker bent or kinked.
solution:
1. Make sure the cold air outlet is not clogged.
2. Make sure the wire connector from the wire housing is connected properly.
3. Make sure the water line in the rear of the refrigerator is not bent or kinked.
safety_warning: Wire connector of the ice maker.
chunk_text: For Auto Ice Maker models, if the ice maker does not produce ice, possible causes include: the freezer room is not cold enough; the wire connector of the ice maker is not connected properly; or the water line flowing to the ice maker is bent or kinked. To resolve this: Make sure the cold air outlet is not clogged. Make sure the wire connector from the wire housing is connected properly. Make sure the water line in the rear of the refrigerator is not bent or kinked.

symptom: Abnormal sounds from the refrigerator (Clicking, Chirping, Buzzing, SSSRRR!, Whir!, HiSS!)
possible_cause: Normal operation when starting/ending operation, fan operating, or water dripping on the defrost heater during a defrost cycle.
safety_warning: Defrost heater causes sizzling sounds.
chunk_text: Abnormal sounds from the refrigerator: The refrigerator may make clicking, chirping, buzzing, whirring (SSSRRR!), or sizzling (HiSS!) sounds. When starting or ending an operation, the refrigerator may make sounds similar to a car engine igniting, which decrease as operation stabilizes. Buzzing or whirring occurs while the fan operates and stops when set temperature is reached. During a defrost cycle, water dripping on the defrost heater causes sizzling sounds. These sounds are normal.

symptom: Abnormal sounds from the refrigerator (Bubbling!, Cracking!, Buzzing!, Whooshing!)
possible_cause: Refrigerant gas moving through sealed pipes, plastic parts contracting/expanding during defrosting or electronic operations, water valve opening to fill ice maker, or pressure equalizing when opening/closing door.
chunk_text: Abnormal sounds from the refrigerator: The refrigerator may make bubbling, cracking, buzzing, or whooshing sounds. Bubbling sounds are caused by refrigerant gas moving through sealed pipes as the refrigerator cools or freezes. Cracking/knocking sounds occur as plastic parts contract and expand when temperature increases or decreases during defrosting or when electronic parts are working. For ice maker models, buzzing sounds occur when the water valve opens to fill the ice maker. Whooshing sounds occur because of pressure equalizing when opening and closing the refrigerator door. These sounds are normal.

possible_cause: Unplugged power, door open, water taps closed, Start/Pause not pressed, Child Lock activated, or blown fuse/circuit breaker.
solution:
1. Make sure the washing machine is plugged in.
2. Make sure the door is properly closed.
3. Make sure the water taps are open.
4. Make sure to press Start/Pause to start the washing machine.
5. Make sure Child Lock is not activated.
6. Check the fuse or reset the circuit breaker.

Before the washing machine starts to fill, it will make a series of clicking noises to check the door lock and does a quick drain. Check the fuse or reset the circuit breaker.

solution:

2. Make sure the detergent is added to the centre of the detergent drawer.
3. Make sure the rinse cap is inserted properly.
4. If using granular detergent, make sure the detergent selector is in the upper position.
5. Remove the rinse cap and clean the detergent drawer.

possible_cause: Unlevel or slippery floor, unremoved shipping bolts, contact with other objects, unbalanced laundry load, normal motor operation, overalls or metal-decorated clothes, or loose metal objects like coins.
solution:
1. Make sure the washing machine is installed on a level, solid floor that is not slippery. If the floor is not level, use the levelling feet to adjust the height of the washing machine.
2. Make sure the shipping bolts are removed.
3. Make sure the washing machine is not contacting any other object.
4. Make sure the laundry load is balanced.
5. Remove metal objects such as coins from the drum or filter case after washing.
chunk_text: If the washing machine experiences excessive vibrations or makes noise, check the following: Make sure the washing machine is installed on a level, solid floor that is not slippery. If the floor is not level, use the levelling feet to adjust the height of the washing machine. Make sure the shipping bolts are removed. Make sure the washing machine is not contacting any other object. Make sure the laundry load is balanced. The motor can cause noise during normal operation. Overalls or metal-decorated clothes can cause noise while being washed, which is normal. Metal objects such as coins can cause noise; after washing, remove these objects from the drum or filter case.

possible_cause: Unplugged power cord, blown fuse/tripped circuit breaker, open door, pause or soak period in cycle, clogged mesh filter at water taps, or insufficient power supply.
solution:
1. Plug the power cord into a live electrical outlet.
2. Check the fuse or reset the circuit breaker.
3. Close the door and press the Start/Pause button to start the washing machine.
4. Wait briefly if the cycle is in a pause or soak period.
5. Check and clean the mesh filter of the water supply hose at the water taps periodically.
safety_warning: Plug the power cord into a live electrical outlet. Check the fuse or reset the circuit breaker. For your safety, the washing machine will not tumble or spin unless the door is closed.
chunk_text: If the washing machine stops during operation, check the following troubleshooting actions: Plug the power cord into a live electrical outlet. Check the fuse or reset the circuit breaker. Close the door and press the Start/Pause button to start the washing machine. For your safety, the washing machine will not tumble or spin unless the door is closed. Before the washing machine starts to fill, it will make a series of clicking noises to check the door lock and does a quick drain. There may be a pause or soak period in the cycle; wait briefly and the washing machine may start. Make sure the mesh filter of the water supply hose at the water taps are not clogged and clean it periodically. If the washing machine is not supplied with sufficient power, the washing machine temporarily will not drain or spin; as soon as it regains sufficient power, it will operate normally.

symptom: Does not drain and/ or spin
possible_cause: Drain restriction, clogged debris filter, open door, frozen or clogged drain hose, clogged drain system, or insufficient power supply.
solution:
1. Make sure the drain hose is straightened all the way to the drain system. If you encounter a drain restriction, call for service.
2. Make sure the debris filter is not clogged.
3. Close the door and press Start/Pause.
4. Make sure the drain hose is not frozen or clogged.
5. Make sure the drain hose is connected to a drain system that is not clogged.
safety_warning: For your safety, the washing machine will not tumble or spin unless the door is closed.
chunk_text: If the washing machine does not drain and/or spin, follow these steps: Make sure the drain hose is straightened all the way to the drain system. If you encounter a drain restriction, call for service. Make sure the debris filter is not clogged. Close the door and press Start/Pause. For your safety, the washing machine will not tumble or spin unless the door is closed. Make sure the drain hose is not frozen or clogged. Make sure the drain hose is connected to a drain system that is not clogged. If the washing machine is not supplied with sufficient power, the washing machine temporarily will not drain or spin. As soon as the washing machine regains sufficient power, it will operate normally.

possible_cause: Unevenly spread laundry or unstable surface.
solution:
1. Make sure laundry is spread out evenly.
2. Make sure the washing machine is on a flat, stable surface.
chunk_text: If spinning does not work on the washing machine, check the following steps: Make sure laundry is spread out evenly in the drum. Make sure the washing machine is placed on a flat, stable surface.

possible_cause: Active door lock mechanism, water remaining in the drum, or door lock light is on.
solution:
1. Press Start/Pause to stop the washing machine.
2. Allow a few moments for the door lock mechanism to disengage.
3. Make sure all water in the drum is drained; drain the drum and open the door manually if water remains.
4. Make sure the door lock light is off.
chunk_text: If the door does not open on the washing machine, take the following steps: Press Start/Pause to stop the washing machine. It may take a few moments for the door lock mechanism to disengage. Make sure all the water in the drum is drained. The door may not open if water remains in the drum; drain the drum and open the door manually. Make sure the door lock light is off, which turns off after the washing machine has drained.

possible_cause: Use of non-HE detergent or excessive detergent for soft water, small loads, or lightly soiled loads.
solution:
1. Make sure you use the recommended types of detergent as appropriate.
2. Use high efficiency (HE) detergent to prevent oversudsing.
3. Reduce the detergent amount for soft water, small loads, or lightly soiled loads.
chunk_text: If excessive suds occur during a wash cycle, perform the following troubleshooting steps: Make sure you use the recommended types of detergent as appropriate. Use high efficiency (HE) detergent to prevent oversudsing. Reduce the detergent amount for soft water, small loads, or lightly soiled loads. Non-HE detergent is not recommended.

possible_cause: Remaining amount of detergent and fabric softener is over the limit.
solution: 1. Make sure the remaining amount of detergent and fabric softener is not over the limit.
chunk_text: If you cannot apply additional detergent, perform this check: Make sure the remaining amount of detergent and fabric softener is not over the limit.

symptom: Fills with the wrong water temperature
possible_cause: Taps not fully open, incorrect temperature selection, hoses connected to wrong taps, water heater set below 120 °F (49 °C), clogged mesh filter, or normal operation of automatic temperature control.
solution:
1. Fully open both taps.
2. Make sure the temperature selection is correct.
3. Make sure the hoses are connected to the correct taps and flush water lines.
4. Make sure the water heater is set to supply a minimum 120 °F (49 °C) hot water at the tap. Also, check the water heater capacity and recovery rate.
5. Disconnect the hoses and clean the mesh filter.
safety_warning: Make sure the water heater is set to supply a minimum 120 °F (49 °C) hot water at the tap.
chunk_text: If the washing machine fills with the wrong water temperature, take the following actions: Fully open both taps. Make sure the temperature selection is correct. Make sure the hoses are connected to the correct taps and flush water lines. Make sure the water heater is set to supply a minimum 120 °F (49 °C) hot water at the tap, and check the water heater capacity and recovery rate. Disconnect the hoses and clean the mesh filter as it may be clogged. While the washing machine fills, the water temperature may change as the automatic temperature control feature checks incoming water temperature. While the washing machine fills, you may notice just hot and/or just cold water going through the dispenser when cold or warm temperatures are selected; this is a normal function of the automatic temperature control feature.

symptom: Load is wet at the end of a cycle
possible_cause: Low spin speed setting, oversudsing from non-HE detergent, small load becoming unbalanced, or kinked/clogged drain hose.
solution:
1. Use the High or Extra High spin speed.
2. Use high efficiency (HE) detergent to reduce oversudsing.
3. Avoid small loads (one or two items) that may become unbalanced.
4. Make sure the drain hose is not kinked or clogged.
chunk_text: If the load is wet at the end of a cycle, check and perform the following troubleshooting steps: Use the High or Extra High spin speed. Use high efficiency (HE) detergent to reduce oversudsing. If the load is too small (one or two items), it may become unbalanced and not spin completely. Make sure the drain hose is not kinked or clogged.

possible_cause: Door not properly closed, loose hose connections, drain hose improperly inserted/secured, overloading, oversudsing, or object stuck between door and diaphragm.
solution:
1. Make sure the door is properly closed.
2. Make sure all hose connections are tight.
3. Make sure the end of the drain hose is correctly inserted and secured to the drain system.
4. Avoid overloading.
5. Use high efficiency (HE) detergent to prevent oversudsing.
6. Check if there is something stuck between the door and the diaphragm and remove it.
chunk_text: If the washing machine leaks water, follow these checks and actions: Make sure the door is properly closed. Make sure all hose connections are tight. Make sure the end of the drain hose is correctly inserted and secured to the drain system. Avoid overloading. Use high efficiency (HE) detergent to prevent oversudsing. Check if there is something stuck between the door and the diaphragm; if something is stuck between the door and the diaphragm, it may cause a leak or damage to the diaphragm.

possible_cause: Excessive suds collecting in recesses.
solution:
1. Run cleansing cycles to sanitize periodically.
2. Clean the door seal (diaphragm).
3. Dry the washing machine interior after a cycle has finished.
chunk_text: If the washing machine has odours, follow these cleaning steps: Excessive suds collect in recesses and can cause foul odours. Run cleansing cycles to sanitize periodically. Clean the door seal (diaphragm). Dry the washing machine interior after a cycle has finished.
